create.name: Centre Sivananda Paris
create.bio:
The Centre Sivananda de Yoga Vedanta in Paris belongs to the international Sivananda Yoga Vedanta organisation, the network Swami Vishnudevananda built to carry the teaching of his guru, Swami Sivananda of Rishikesh. Swami Kailasananda, a long-time disciple of Vishnudevananda who directs the organisation's centres in France and England, oversees it, and Swami Shantananda runs the Paris centre day to day. It is set up as a non-profit association and staffed mostly by volunteer teachers working in the spirit of karma yoga, in a building with three practice rooms a short walk from the Gare de l'Est in the 10th arrondissement.

The yoga taught here is the classical Sivananda form of hatha yoga: twelve basic postures, breathing practice, deep relaxation, a vegetarian diet, positive thinking and meditation, framed by the four paths of karma, bhakti, raja and jnana yoga. A weekly timetable of classes runs alongside six-week beginners' and progression courses, a four-week introduction to meditation, kirtan and philosophy workshops and festival days, plus one online class a week. Group meditation with chanting and a talk is open to all without charge several times a week. Students who want to teach go on to the month-long Sivananda Teacher Training Course, held mainly at the organisation's ashram near Orléans, and later to its advanced training.

courses.title: Sivananda Yoga Teacher Training Course (TTC)
courses.description: The organisation's founding teacher training, a residential month of daily meditation, asana and pranayama practice, lectures on yoga philosophy, chanting and teaching practice, leading to the Yoga Siromani certificate at the 200-hour standard. French-language courses run several times a year at the Sivananda ashram near Orléans, about an hour from Paris.

courses.title: Sivananda Advanced Teacher Training Course (ATTC)
courses.description: A second residential month for graduates of the teacher training, going further into advanced pranayama and postures, the Yoga Sutras of Patanjali, Vedanta philosophy, Sanskrit and the subtle body. Sessions are listed at the Orléans ashram, in Austria and in the Himalayas.

courses.title: Sivananda yoga courses for beginners and beyond
courses.description: Six weekly sessions of ninety minutes that build a steady practice in stages: a first course on the twelve basic postures and full yogic breathing, a second that adds variations and the headstand, and a progression course with kriyas, concentration and mantra.

courses.title: Discovering meditation
courses.description: Four evening sessions of ninety minutes that explain the stages of meditation in the Sivananda tradition, with guided sitting each time and an introduction to working with mantras.

courses.title: Pack Une année de Bien-Être
courses.description: A twelve-month package of unlimited classes with membership of the association, one course and one workshop of your choice, a private session, and a discount on stays at the Sivananda ashram. Class cards and other subscriptions are on the same page.

free_resources.title: Group meditation (satsang)
free_resources.description: Open sessions at the centre of half an hour of silent sitting, half an hour of mantra chanting and a short talk on yoga philosophy, held on Wednesday evenings and at weekends. Entry is free.

flags: Domain sivanandaparis.org came from a search summary and was confirmed on the site's own pages, which name the Centre Sivananda de Yoga Vedanta Paris; www redirects to the bare host. robots.txt (both hosts) allows all with Crawl-delay: 30, which was honoured.

Part of the international Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres network (a lineage organisation, not a commercial franchise); Instituto Sivananda DLS Brasil and the Bahamas ashram are separate plans. Owner may want to check the network fits 'not franchises'.

The teacher trainings are run by the organisation and held mainly at its ashram near Orléans (and abroad), not at the Paris building; the Paris centre promotes them and prepares students for them. Next French TTC starts 14 Nov 2026; sessions are listed on one page, so the items are undated.
Email paris@sivananda.net is the centre's office inbox; a contact form is on the same page.
No founding year on the site (a search snippet said 1977, not used).
Prices for classes, courses and the trainings are not in the page text (shown via a booking widget), so 'Contact for pricing'.
One video (93LZF08fkAs, 'Cours de yoga pour votre bien-être…') is embedded on the site and passes oEmbed, but its length can't be checked without a watch page, and it looks promotional; left out.
Possible future listings: Swami Kailasananda (director of the Sivananda centres in France and England; author of 'Le Yoga de la Méditation'), Swami Shantananda (director of the Paris centre).
